description: Pakistan Refinery Limited was established in 1960 and operates from a main refinery at Korangi Creek and a crude terminal at Keamari in Karachi, with a processing capacity of about 50,000 barrels per day. It refines imported and local crude oil into petroleum fuels supplied to oil marketing companies and institutional clients, and is taking forward a Refinery Expansion & Upgrade Project (REUP) aimed at producing cleaner fuels to international specifications.
headOffice: P.O. Box 4612, Korangi Creek Road, Karachi 75190, Pakistan
